cases_full.question: What are the 5 most expensive products?

attempt_history.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT p.ProductKey, p.EnglishProductName, p.ProductSubcategoryKey, 
           d.EnglishProductSubcategoryName, p.ListPrice,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ProductSubcategoryKey ORDER BY p.ListPrice DESC) AS rn
    FROM FactInternetSales p
    JOIN DimProductSubcategory d ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = d.ProductSubcategoryKey
)
SELECT ProductKey, EnglishProductName, ProductSubcategoryKey, EnglishProductSubcategoryName, ListPrice
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
